requirement: On the web a vendor sign-in (Connect now, Open sign-in page, the Security and key links) opens in a new browser tab with an address bar, never a popup window; in the desktop app it still opens in the person's browser

oracle.ref: PR #1233 (fix); fix evidence: web cowork.tracy.site 12/10/2026 11:07 and 14:28: Connect Claude opened claude.ai in a popup window (no address bar, title 'Claude', Chrome's ⋮ menu) because openExternal / the pane's openBrowser called window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer'); the sign-in ends on http://localhost:53692/callback?code=… which the person must copy from the address bar. Opened by hand in a tab (13:16 screenshot) it worked.
oracle.invariant: openExternal(url) on the web never calls window.open: it appends one <a href=url target=_blank rel='noopener noreferrer'>, clicks it while attached, and removes it; in the desktop app it calls tracyDesktop.links.openExternal(url) and touches no anchor. Connect now with a browser answer opens the authorize URL as one tab (tab:https://claude.ai/x), not window.open; the device panel's Open {vendor} button does the same. The panel's Open sign-in page [data-action='reopen'], the ChatGPT Settings › Security link and Where to get a key have target _blank and rel 'noopener noreferrer'; on the web a click is not prevented (one tab: entry, nothing else opens); in the desktop app it is prevented and opened through the app's links (app: then held:).
oracle.productSourceGap: no product file is imported, read or run through a supported form in the command's test files (see tests/qa/layers/unit/lib/sources.mjs)
